note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, from the official descriptions only — the game launched 19 November 2026 and no verified playthrough exists yet, so no specific location or step is claimed unless the official description states it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This trophy unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 are earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Treat it as the finish line of the four-stage road trip in this guide: story first, then activities and skills, then collectibles and exploration, and finally money and cleanup. Because the game launched today, no verified playthrough exists yet, so this guide builds only on the official description and flags anything unconfirmed instead of guessing. Source: Exophase — official list (name, description, grade).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long game: 100% completion in a GTA title counts story missions plus a checklist of side content — activities, collectibles, stranger missions and more. Work through this guide's four stages in order and keep the in-game stats page open to see what is still missing. The exact 100% checklist has not been confirmed in-game yet, so this guide claims no list beyond the official description. Expect this to be one of the last trophies you earn. Source: Exophase — official list (name, description, grade).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's tracked trick moves — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime are the usual suspects in this series, and the game counts each one toward the 250. Fold stunt attempts into normal driving rather than grinding them all at once: take jumps, thread traffic and catch air whenever you travel. Which moves count as stunts has not been confirmed in-game yet, so this guide claims no stunt list beyond the official description and the PSN-tracked count of 250. Sources: Exophase — official list; PSNProfiles — PSN count (250).

Sources: Exophase — official list; PSNProfiles — PSN count (10).

roadmap.title: Stop 1 — The Story
roadmap.subtitle: Play the main story in order: the opening mission, Chapters 1–4, the named missions, the final mission and 100% completion.
roadmap.advice: Do the story first and in order. Every chapter and named-mission trophy unlocks as you play; missable story trophies cannot be recovered if mission replay does not exist, so finish each named mission when the story presents it.

roadmap.title: Stop 2 — Activities & Skills
roadmap.subtitle: Races, shooting range, stunts, fishing, arcade, bowling, combat focus and the odd one-off challenges.
roadmap.advice: Sample every activity once for Master of None, then grind the counted ones — 250 stunts, 42 shooting range golds, 20 race wins, 14 drone race wins — and pick off the one-off tricks (arcade, bowling, showroom, VCIA) as you travel.

roadmap.title: Stop 3 — Collectibles & Exploration
roadmap.subtitle: Cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots, vehicles, areas, garages and the Scooter Bros app.
roadmap.advice: Sweep Leonida properly: 52 areas, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK spots, 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Collect as you travel and the challenge count (50) grows on its own.

roadmap.title: Stop 4 — Cleanup & Fortune
roadmap.subtitle: Stranger strands, partner trophies, vaults, gang operations, laundering and spending — then the platinum.
roadmap.advice: Finish the stranger strands and the named-character finales, do the partner trophies while your partner is beside you, then rob 5 vaults and one operation per gang, launder $250,000 of Marked Bills and spend $100,000. The platinum pops when the last of these lands.

online_note: This game lists no online trophies: all 55 trophies are earned in single-player. The Online filter therefore shows 0 trophies — it is kept so the filter list matches the competition's kinds exactly.
